trace.final:
I deployed the checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions and opened the SEV3 incident. The service is now healthy.

1. **Approval:** v2.3.2 had never run in production, so policy required change-manager approval. I asked for it and got it before deploying.
2. **Deploy:** v2.3.2 is now live in us-east, us-west and eu-west, replacing v2.3.1. Before the deploy, v2.3.1 was unhealthy with an 18% error rate.
3. **Incident:** I opened SEV3 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api to record the change, which paged the on-call engineer.
4. **After the deploy:** checkout-api reports healthy, and the error rate dropped from 18% to 0.2%.

If you need to roll back, v2.3.0 is the last version that was healthy in production before this one.
